newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,052 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,052 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,052 contracts compared with 1,043 overnight Tuesday.
There were 235 wheat, 242 corn, 470 soybean, 67 soymeal, four rice, 11 corn calls, 10 soybean calls and 13 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent higher to 2-1/4 cents lower, corn was 3/4 to 1-1/2 cents lower and soybeans were eight cents higher to 2-1/2 cents lower.
